weekly_volume.weekly_sets: 11 direct (Mon 6 heavy press+flye, Fri 5 pump press+crossover)
weekly_volume.note: 2x/wk. Anchors are neutral-grip/incline DB + machine/Smith press (shoulder-crepitus friendly), not heavy strict barbell. Heavy day 5-10 reps @1-2 RIR on fixed-core press; pump day 10-25 reps @0-2 RIR on machine/cable with constant tension. Flat vs incline chosen for ROM/comfort, NOT to 'target' a region (incline upper-pec growth is disputed; combining to maximize is refuted).

2x/wk vertical pull. Grip orientation/width chosen for joint comfort and stretch ROM, NOT lat-region targeting (refuted). Heavy day = weighted/neutral pull-up or iso-lateral pulldown 6-12; pump day = single-arm pulldown + lat-prayer/straight-arm for lengthened bias. Straps/FTS cuffs bypass left-pinky grip.

2x/wk row. Both horizontal rows and vertical pulls programmed for complete back coverage (the row-vs-pulldown split is a sensible heuristic, not proven differential growth). Chest-supported/Smith rows on the Pull days that follow leg work keep lower-back fresh; free barbell row used Tue with straps.

WEAK-POINT BUILD. No 45/GHD/back-ext machine exists, so erectors are loaded as PRIMARY via conventional/deficit deadlift + good-morning (Wed), heavy-SECONDARY via RDL/SLDL and all barbell rows, and isometrically via farmer's/suitcase carries. Painless = progress. Heavy hinge sits Wed before Thu rest; kept off Tue/Sat sport days. Trained 3-4x/wk across hinges+rows+carries to accumulate the high volume safely.

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: 12-14 (Sun 3, Wed 3, plus anti-rotation/carry on push/pull days)
weekly_volume.note: WEAK-POINT BUILD, trained ~4-5x/wk in short doses. Spans all three core functions: spinal-flexion (cable/weighted crunch, hanging leg raise - loaded, progressible, 8-20 reps @0-2 RIR), anti-extension (ab-wheel rollout, weighted plank), anti-lateral-flexion/anti-rotation (suitcase carry, cable/DB side bend). Bracing core + erectors together is the functional-strength + running-tightness fix.

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: ~16 fractional (Sun 5 squat-bias, Wed 3, +indirect from hinges/lunges/calf-press patterns)
weekly_volume.note: 2x/wk, legs FULLY trained. Sun = quad-biased squat (high-bar/front/Smith) to deep ROM (deep squat supported for leg growth) 5-10 @1-2 RIR + leg extension. Reclined/extended-hip leg extension added to bias rectus femoris (a supported claim). Wed quads are accessory to the hinge.

2x/wk via BOTH movement patterns (supported hamstring split): hip-hinge (RDL/SLDL/good-morning - hip-extensor heads) on Wed, and a knee-flexion leg curl - SEATED prioritized (grows hip-extensor heads more, supported) plus lying for the short head. Wed heavy hinge 5-10 @1-3 RIR; curls 12-30 @0-2 RIR.

2x/wk. Complementary length coverage: long-length via squat + RDL/deficit hinge (Wed), short-length via hip thrust/glute bridge (machine/Smith/barbell). Hip thrust is included for the short-length emphasis it ADDS, not as superior to squat for growth (that claim is refuted). Abduction (cable/machine) for medius/minimus.

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: ~6-8 fractional (Sun 2 direct + heavy indirect from deep squats/sumo/lunges)
weekly_volume.note: Adductor magnus is a major hip extensor at squat/hinge depth, so most stimulus is indirect; direct work = Copenhagen plank (also anti-lateral-flexion core) and hip-adduction machine/cable on Sun. Deep/wide stance loads them further.

Train BOTH heads by knee angle (supported): standing/knee-straight raises for gastrocnemius (incl. lengthened-partial bottom range), seated/leg-press bent-knee raise for soleus. 10-30 reps @0-1 RIR. Single-leg ankle-stabilizer raise feeds tib-post/fibularis for functional ankle robustness.

2x/wk, the main delt driver since pressing is shoulder-conservative. Cable/cuff/machine lateral raises (grip-bypass, loaded-stretch bottom) 12-30 @0-2 RIR. Cable chosen for tension profile/comfort; not claimed superior to DB for growth (refuted).

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: ~9-12 (Tue 3, Fri 3, Sat 3 + indirect from all rows)
weekly_volume.note: Trained with Pull and as Push-day antagonist filler. Face pulls + rear-delt flies/cuff flies + high-row path. Doubles as scapular-health/posture work for the desk-and-running lifter.

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: ~12-14 fractional (4 direct + heavy indirect from all pressing)
weekly_volume.note: Mostly indirect from chest/overhead pressing; minimal direct front raise needed. Overhead pressing done as shoulder-friendly neutral-grip DB / landmine / Smith / machine seated press (no heavy strict barbell OHP per crepitus constraint).
Prehab for the crepitus shoulder: cable/DB external & internal rotation, full-can raise. Light 12-20 @1-3 RIR. Not hypertrophy volume - joint-stability insurance that lets the presses stay painless.

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: ~14-16 fractional (Tue 4 + Sat 4 direct, heavy indirect from chins/rows)
weekly_volume.note: 2x/wk on Pull. Lengthened-bias curl (incline DB) prioritized over peak-contraction (supported modest edge). Heavy EZ/DB curl 5-12 @1-3 RIR Tue; cable/spider pump 10-30 @0-2 RIR Sat. Cuffs/straps for pinky on any hanging load.

weekly_volume.weekly_sets: ~15-18 fractional (Mon 5 + Fri 4 direct, heavy indirect from all presses)
weekly_volume.note: 2x/wk on Push - and triceps specifically benefit from >20 total sets (synergist), which the indirect pressing supplies. Heavy day = close-grip/JM/overhead EZ extension 5-12 @1-2 RIR; pump day = rope pushdown + overhead cable 15-30 @0-2 RIR (long-head stretch).

Neutral-grip + wrap friendly (wrist tendinopathy). Wrist curl/reverse curl + carries; reverse curl & hammer for brachioradialis. Note: left-pinky crush-grip work (gripper/pinch/dead-hang) is deferred while the pinky is symptomatic - use FTS cuffs/straps to keep training the rest.

anchors: Fixed-core: quad-biased squat to deep ROM (High-Bar / Front / Smith Squat), 3-4 x 5-10 @ 1-2 RIR
day_plan.emphasis: Quad + short-length glute day; moderate so it doesn't pre-fatigue the heavy Wed hinge. Squat is the strength anchor; rest builds the pump.
day_plan.note: Accessory framework after the squat: Leg Extension incl. one reclined/extended-hip set (rectus-femoris bias, supported) 12-25 @0-1 RIR; Seated Leg Curl (hip-extensor heads, supported) 12-30 @0-2; Hip Thrust or Glute Bridge for short-length glute 10-20 @1-2; Hip-Adduction machine + Copenhagen 12-25; STANDING calf raise (gastroc) 10-20 @0-1. Core: Cable Crunch + Hanging Leg Raise + Suitcase Carry. Quad RIR moderate (squat 2 RIR) to protect Wed.

anchors: Fixed-core: heavy shoulder-friendly press - Incline/Flat Dumbbell or Machine/Smith Press, 4 x 5-10 @ 1-2 RIR (neutral/angled grip; jaw relaxed)
day_plan.emphasis: The heavier of the two Push days - lower reps, fixed-core press first while fresh, strength-leaning compounds.
day_plan.note: After the press anchor: second press (the angle you didn't anchor with) 6-12 @1-2; Close-Grip Bench or JM Press for heavy triceps 6-12 @1-2; Cable/Machine Lateral Raise 12-20 @0-2; Overhead EZ Triceps Extension (long-head) 10-20 @1-3. No strict heavy barbell OHP (crepitus). Most sets 1-3 RIR, only last isolation set to failure. Rear-delt face pull as antagonist filler. TMJ: unclench/mouthguard on top press sets.

anchors: Fixed-core: heavy vertical pull (Weighted/Neutral-grip Pull-Up or Iso-Lateral Pulldown) 5-10 @ 1-2 RIR; Fixed-core: Barbell/T-Bar Row with straps 6-12 @ 1-2 RIR
day_plan.emphasis: Strength-leaning Pull but CONTROLLED total fatigue and NOT taken deep to failure on big lifts - kickboxing is the same evening, so leave gas in the tank (autoregulate up RIR if legs/CNS feel pre-cooked).
day_plan.note: Pull (not legs/push) chosen on the kickboxing day to avoid pre-fatiguing kick-relevant musculature. Accessories: chest-supported row 10-15; lengthened biceps (Incline DB Curl) 8-12 @1-3; Face Pull + rear-delt fly 12-25; neutral-grip wrist/reverse curl. Straps/FTS cuffs bypass left-pinky on all hanging/heavy-grip pulls. Keep big-lift sets at 2-3 RIR today, not 0-1.

anchors: Fixed-core: heavy hip-hinge - Conventional or Deficit Deadlift (erector + glute + ham PRIMARY), 3-4 x 5-8 @ 2-3 RIR with straps; or Barbell Good-Morning/RDL as the hinge if pulling from floor isn't fresh
day_plan.emphasis: The erector/lower-back PRIORITY engine and the heavier Legs day. Placed Wed so the most fatiguing hinge is immediately followed by Thu full rest. Hinge first while fresh; long rests (3-4 min).
day_plan.note: This is where the weak point is built. After the deadlift: RDL or SLDL for ham/erector at long length 6-10 @1-3; Seated + Lying Leg Curl 12-30 @0-2; Hip Thrust 10-20; SEATED (bent-knee) calf raise for soleus + one standing for gastroc; heavy anti-extension/anti-rotation core (Ab-Wheel Rollout + Farmer's/Suitcase Carry). Hinge at 2-3 RIR (Helms: spare the spine on the big compound, chase failure on isolation). Painless = progress load weekly; stop on any red-flag (leg radiation/numbness).

anchors: Full recovery (optional easy mobility / hip-flexor + T-spine, light walking)
day_plan.emphasis: Hard rest after the heavy Wed hinge - protects the lower-back priority work and resets CNS before Fri.
day_plan.note: No lifting. If a sport session lands here, keep it light/skills-only. This rest is what makes the high erector/core volume recoverable.

anchors: Fixed-core (lighter): Machine/Smith Incline or Seated DB Press, 3-4 x 10-15 @ 1-2 RIR - moderate load, higher reps than Monday
day_plan.emphasis: The PUMP Push - higher reps, constant-tension cable/machine work, shorter rests, advanced techniques for TIME-EFFICIENCY (not more growth). Differs from Mon by load/rep/structure while hitting the same muscles 2nd time.
day_plan.note: Cable Flye/Crossover 12-30 @0-2; Rope Pushdown + Overhead Cable Extension with an optional drop-set or myo-reps (matched-volume equivalent - used to save time) 15-30; Machine/Cuff Lateral Raise high-rep 12-30; rotator-cuff prehab (external rotation, full-can) 12-20. Isolation taken to 0-1 RIR / failure where cheap. Antagonist supersets (press+row-ish rear delt) to compress session time.

anchors: Fixed-core (lighter): Chest-Supported / Iso-Lateral Row 10-15 @ 1-2 RIR (low lower-back demand after krav); + Single-Arm Cable Pulldown / Lat-Prayer for lengthened lats 10-20
day_plan.emphasis: The PUMP/lighter Pull - lower spinal-loading (chest-supported, cable, machine) because krav was this morning and Wed already hit erectors hard. Higher reps, stretch-biased lat work, no heavy free-barbell row today.
day_plan.note: Spread biceps 2nd session: Cable/Spider Curl + Hammer/Reverse Curl 10-30 @0-2; Rear-delt fly + Face Pull 12-25; neutral-grip forearm work + a light carry. Autoregulate: if krav was brutal, drop a set or raise RIR - the lifting is self-sufficient, sports don't count as training volume. Straps/cuffs for pinky. Lighter load preserves recovery into next week's Sun.

plan.principles:
RIR TARGETS (evidence-based): Heavy compounds (squat, deadlift, hinge, fixed-core press/pull) = 2-3 RIR most sets, reserving 0-1 RIR for the very last set only - failure on big barbell lifts is slightly INFERIOR for strength and triples acute neuromuscular fatigue (Robinson/Ruple/Refalo), and on the deadlift it threatens the priority lower-back. Isolation/machine/cable = 0-2 RIR, final set often to failure (cheap fatigue, captures the small hypertrophy premium). At light loads (high-rep cable/calf) train 0-1 RIR so high-threshold units are recruited. Strength-leaning compound work can sit 3-5 RIR and still build strength at matched volume.

PROGRESSION: Double progression - add reps within each exercise's prescribed range, then add load (5-lb barbell steps / next DB) once the top of the range is hit at target RIR. Run ~4-6 week accumulation blocks ramping volume from the low end (~12 sets/muscle) toward the high end (~18-20) and RIR DOWN within the block (e.g. start ~3-4 RIR, finish ~1 RIR) - matched gains at lower average RPE (Martikainen). Then a deload week at ~half volume and 3-6 RIR to shed accumulated fatigue, and restart. The erector/core priority gets the high end of its range and the most consistent weekly load progression because it's painless and trainable - but only while it stays painless (any leg radiation, numbness, give-way, night pain = stop and reassess).

AUTOREGULATION AROUND VARIABLE SPORTS (the lifting is self-sufficient; sports are NOT counted as training volume): The plan is built to stand alone, so on heavy-sport-overlap weeks you AUTOREGULATE the lifting down rather than leaning on the sport for stimulus. Levers, in order: (1) raise RIR by 1-2 on the affected session, (2) drop the last 1-2 accessory sets, (3) on a Tue (pre-kickboxing) or Sat (post-krav) keep big lifts at 2-3 RIR and never to failure. Pull is deliberately scheduled on the kickboxing day (Tue) and the lighter chest-supported Pull after krav (Sat) so leg/push power is fresh for the sport; the heavy fatiguing hinge is isolated to Wed -> Thu rest. If a sport session is unusually brutal, the missing lifting volume is made up later in the week or simply skipped - never added on top into overreaching.

CONSTRAINT INTEGRATION (always on): Shoulder painless-crepitus -> neutral-grip DB / landmine / incline / Smith / machine presses are the press anchors; NO heavy strict barbell overhead press; rotator-cuff + scapular work every Push/Pull. Wrist tendinopathy -> neutral-grip variants, wrist wraps, cable/machine where the wrist stays neutral. Left pinky (temporary) -> FTS cable wrist cuffs / lifting straps / machine-loaded variants on every grip-loaded pull, hinge, and carry; defer crush-grip (gripper/pinch/dead-hang) until it settles. TMJ -> jaw relaxed / mouthguard, no hard clench on any heavy or valsalva set.

EXERCISE-SELECTION LOGIC (from the verified claims): Picks are justified by ROM/muscle-length, stimulus-to-fatigue ratio, and constraint-fit - NOT by EMG/pump 'targeting' (acute EMG and pump do NOT predict regional growth - refuted). Claims I actively USED: standing (gastroc) vs seated (soleus) calf raises; seated leg curl for the hip-extensor hamstring heads; hip-hinge vs leg-curl hamstring split (program BOTH); reclined/extended-hip leg extension for rectus femoris; the modest lengthened-position growth edge (incline curl, lat-prayer, stretch-loaded raises, deep squat). Claims I deliberately did NOT lean on: grip steers lat region, hip-thrust > squat for glute growth, behind-neck press, incline-maximizes-or-combine-for-upper-pec, leg-press/squat-stance muscle reallocation - so the hip thrust is in for the short-length emphasis it adds (not as a squat replacement), and multiple press/pull angles are in for coverage and joint variety (not as proven region-specific growth). Advanced techniques (drop sets, rest-pause, myo-reps, supersets, pyramids) are EQUIVALENT to straight sets at matched volume, so they appear ONLY on the pump days (Fri Push, Sat Pull) purely for time-efficiency and fatigue management - never as a way to claim extra growth. Frequency is the volume vehicle (2x/muscle via PPLx2 satisfies the >=2x floor; beyond that it's logistics), and hypertrophy is load-independent from ~30-85% near failure, which is exactly why each muscle's two weekly sessions are split into one heavier/lower-rep and one lighter/higher-rep pass."

sessions.session_name: PUSH A — Heavy / Strength (chest, delts, triceps)

exercises.load_guidance: Start the heavy press while fresh. ~30-deg incline. Begin 60s x6-8 (the 60-lb pair). Double-progress: when you hit 8 reps at target RIR on all 4 sets, jump to the next pair (65 -> 70 -> 75). DB caps at 75/hand — when 75s x8 feel like 2+ RIR, switch the heavy-press slot to Smith Incline Press (loadable past the DB ceiling) and demote DBs to the pump-volume role. ~30s drop to set the dumbbells down each set; use knee-kickup to get them up.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression
exercises.cues: Neutral-to-45-deg angled grip, elbows ~45-60 deg from torso (not flared to 90), drive to a deep but pain-free stretch at the bottom, press up and slightly back. Control the eccentric ~2s. Keep the bar path over the upper chest, not the throat.
exercises.accommodation: Shoulder painless-crepitus: incline DB IS the shoulder-friendly anchor (neutral/angled grip, self-selected path) — this replaces heavy strict barbell OHP. Wrist tendinopathy: angled/semi-neutral grip keeps the wrist stacked; wrist wraps allowed. Left pinky: do NOT hang the 60-75s from a closed hand at the bottom of the rack — use the knee-kickup to load and a controlled set-down; if the pinky catches, swap to the Smith Incline (machine-loaded, grip-bypassed). TMJ: relax jaw / soft bite (or mouthguard) on the top set, no hard clench.

exercises.load_guidance: Second press, the angle you didn't anchor with (flat). Fixed bar path lets you load past the DB ceiling and stay safe near failure solo. Smith effective bar ~25 lb; start ~135 effective (25 bar + 2x55) x8 @2 RIR. RPT: top set heaviest, then strip ~10-15% for the back-off set to chase a couple more reps. Add 5-10 lb when you clear 10 reps at 2 RIR.
exercises.set_structure: RPT (reverse-pyramid: heavy top set first, ~10-15% drop for the back-off) — for time-efficiency, NOT extra growth
exercises.cues: Slight arch, shoulder blades pinned down/back, touch ~lower-sternum, elbows tucked ~45 deg. The fixed path means you can push the back-off set close to failure without a spotter.
exercises.accommodation: Shoulder: flat Smith is a fixed, controllable path — safer than free barbell for the crepitus shoulder; keep ROM pain-free. Wrist: wraps allowed; the bar sits in a stacked wrist. Left pinky: bar is machine-loaded so grip is bypassed. TMJ: jaw soft on the top set.

exercises.load_guidance: Heavy triceps compound (medial/lateral heads + pressing carryover). Use the Smith for a solo-safe fixed path. Grip ~shoulder-width (not narrower — protects the wrist). Start ~115 effective x8 @2 RIR, add 5 lb when you clear 10 at 1-2 RIR. This is the heaviest triceps stimulus of the week and feeds the >20-set triceps total via indirect pressing volume.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression
exercises.cues: Shoulder-width grip (going too narrow loads the wrist, not more triceps), elbows tucked, touch lower chest, full lockout to load the triceps. Keep the bar over the elbows.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist tendinopathy: keep the grip shoulder-width (a too-narrow grip cranks wrist extension) and use wraps; the Smith keeps the wrist stacked. Left pinky: Smith bar is machine-loaded — grip bypassed. Shoulder: tucked elbows and moderate ROM keep it shoulder-friendly. TMJ: relaxed jaw on heavy sets.

exercises.load_guidance: The main delt driver on Push (pressing is deliberately shoulder-conservative, so direct lateral work carries side-delt growth). Selectorized stack (Precor) — grip- and core-free. Start a load you can clean for 12-15 with 1 RIR; double-progress reps to 15 then add one plate. Even on the heavy day, laterals stay 12-15 (the joint hates low-rep heavy abduction).
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression (last set to failure — cheap isolation fatigue)
exercises.cues: Lead with the elbow, raise to ~shoulder height in the frontal plane, brief pause, control down. Don't shrug — keep the upper trap quiet.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist + left pinky: machine pad/handle means grip is essentially bypassed — no DB to hang from the pinky. Shoulder: raising to ~shoulder height (not overhead) and the smooth machine arc keep it crepitus-friendly. Isolation, so taking the last set to failure is fine (failure only on isolation per the evidence rules).

exercises.load_guidance: Long-head stretch bias (overhead = long head lengthened) to complement the elbow-at-side close-grip work. Fixed/EZ bar 20-60 lb in 10-lb steps, or load an Olympic EZ. Start ~50-60 lb x10-12 @2 RIR; when 12 reps feel like 2 RIR, add 5-10 lb. Heavier than the cable version, so it sits on the strength day.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression
exercises.cues: Elbows tucked and pointed forward, lower behind the head to a full long-head stretch, extend without flaring. Keep the upper arms still.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist tendinopathy: EZ bar's angled grip is wrist-friendlier than a straight bar — use it; wraps allowed. Left pinky: if catching the bar overhead is uncomfortable, load via the cable rope overhead version instead (grip-bypassed) — but keep the long-head stretch. TMJ: relaxed jaw.

exercises.load_guidance: Antagonist/postural filler to balance all the anterior pressing (desk-and-running lifter). FTS cable + wrist cuffs, light — start a load you can control for 15-20 with 1 RIR. Superset these in the rest of the lateral raise or close-grip to compress session time. Not counted as a primary Push muscle — joint-health and shoulder-balance insurance.
exercises.set_structure: antagonist-superset with the lateral raise / close-grip (time-efficiency)
exercises.cues: Slight forward lean, lead with the pinky/elbow, squeeze the rear delt, control the return. Keep it strict and light.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: FTS wrist cuffs put the load on the wrist, fully bypassing the grip — this is the named grip-bypass tool. Wrist: cuff keeps the wrist neutral. Shoulder: external-rotation/horizontal-abduction pattern is prehab-friendly for the crepitus shoulder.

sessions.session_name: PUSH B — Pump / Metabolite (chest, delts, triceps, rotator cuff)

exercises.load_guidance: Lighter, higher-rep press anchor — same muscles as Monday, different load/rep so the 2nd weekly chest pass is the high-rep half (hypertrophy is load-independent ~30-85% near failure). Smith bar ~25 lb effective; start ~95-115 effective x12 @2 RIR. Double-progress to 15 reps then add 5-10 lb. Fixed path keeps it safe near failure and quick to re-rack between sets.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression
exercises.cues: ~30-deg bench, elbows ~45 deg, touch upper chest, control the stretch, smooth turnaround — chase a deep pump, not a grind. Shorter rests than Monday.
exercises.accommodation: Shoulder: fixed Smith path + incline angle = the shoulder-friendly press; keep ROM pain-free. Wrist: stacked wrist, wraps allowed. Left pinky: machine-loaded bar, grip bypassed. TMJ: relaxed jaw (loads are submaximal here, low clench risk).

exercises.load_guidance: Constant-tension peak-contraction chest to round out the 2nd weekly chest pass (no pec-deck in the 290 gym, so cable flye is the machine-pec stand-in). Start light enough for 15-20 clean reps; on the final set run a single drop (~drop one plate, no rest, rep to failure) for time-efficient extra reps. Cable is chosen for the tension profile/comfort, not as superior to DB flye for growth.
exercises.set_structure: drop-set on the final set (for time-efficiency, not more growth)
exercises.cues: Soft elbows fixed, hug the cables together to full peak contraction, control the stretch. High-to-low and low-to-high handle heights are interchangeable for variety/comfort, not region-targeting.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky + wrist: cable handles are low grip-demand and the wrist stays neutral; if the pinky catches, slip on the FTS wrist cuffs. Shoulder: limit the stretch to pain-free range — no forced deep stretch on the crepitus shoulder.

exercises.load_guidance: 2nd weekly lateral-delt pass — higher reps, loaded-stretch at the bottom (cable keeps tension where the DB has none). FTS cable + wrist cuffs. Start a load good for 15-20 with 1 RIR. On the last 1-2 sets run myo-reps: activation set to ~0-1 RIR, then 3-4 mini-sets of ~4-5 reps with ~15s rests to accumulate effective reps fast. Add load when the activation set clears 25.
exercises.set_structure: myo-reps on the final sets (time-efficiency / fatigue management — matched-volume equivalent to straight sets)
exercises.cues: Cuff on the wrist, lead with the elbow, control the loaded stretch at the bottom, raise to shoulder height. On myo-rep mini-sets keep form tight — stop the cluster when reps get sloppy.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: FTS wrist cuffs are the confirmed grip-bypass — load rides the wrist, the closed hand does nothing. Wrist: cuff keeps it neutral, no gripping. Shoulder: raise to ~shoulder height only; the cable's smooth arc is crepitus-friendly.

exercises.load_guidance: Lateral/medial-head pump work, very high SFR. Start a load good for ~18-20 reps with 1 RIR; on the final set run a double-drop (rep to failure, strip one plate, repeat) for cheap metabolite volume in minimal time. Spread the triceps volume across the week — this plus Monday's heavy close-grip/overhead keeps total triceps sets in the >20 range that synergist triceps benefit from.
exercises.set_structure: drop-set on the final set (time-efficiency)
exercises.cues: Elbows pinned to the sides (long head shortened — that's intentional, the overhead move next covers the stretch), spread the rope at lockout, full squeeze, control the return.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist + left pinky: rope is low grip-demand and the wrist stays neutral — friendly to both. No clench/jaw concern at these loads.

exercises.load_guidance: Long-head stretch bias to pair with the pushdown (which keeps the long head short). Constant cable tension at the lengthened position. Start a load good for 15-18 reps with 1-2 RIR; double-progress reps to 20 then add a plate. Superset back-to-back with the rope pushdown (same station) to compress time.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression (optionally agonist-superset with the pushdown for density)
exercises.cues: Step forward into a split stance, elbows high and forward, reach into a full overhead long-head stretch, extend without flaring the elbows. Keep upper arms still.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist + left pinky: rope, low grip-demand, neutral wrist — grip effectively bypassed. Shoulder: the overhead reach is loaded through the elbow (cable), not a pressing shoulder position — keep it pain-free.

exercises.load_guidance: Rotator-cuff prehab for the crepitus shoulder — joint-stability insurance that keeps the presses painless, NOT hypertrophy volume. Very light: a load you control cleanly for 15-20 reps with 2-3 RIR, elbow pinned to the side, full pain-free arc. Progress slowly (this is the smallest jump on the stack). Pair with a Full-Can Raise set if you want fuller cuff/supraspinatus coverage.
exercises.set_structure: straight sets (prehab — never to failure)
exercises.cues: Elbow tucked to the ribs (towel under the elbow), forearm rotates out like a gate, slow and controlled, no momentum. Stop short of failure — this is insurance, not a hard set.
exercises.accommodation: Shoulder painless-crepitus: this is the dedicated cuff/scapular-stability work the constraint asks for on every Push/Pull — it lets the presses stay painless. Wrist + left pinky: cable handle is light and the wrist stays neutral; cuff it if the pinky catches. Keep loads light enough that grip is never the limiter.

sessions.session_name: PULL A — Heavy / Controlled (before kickboxing PM)

exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight first while fresh. Once you clear 8 clean reps at 2-3 RIR, add load via a plate or DB hung from a dip belt (plates in 5-lb steps; DBs to 75). Start ~+10-25 lb; double-progress 5-8 reps then +5 lb. If you cannot get 5 reps at 2-3 RIR, regress to Assisted Pull-Up (machine) or Iso-Lateral Pulldown for the same set count.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression (this is the heavy vertical anchor; keep gas in the tank — kickboxing is tonight, so do NOT grind to failure)
exercises.cues: Neutral grip is the joint-friendly default; initiate by depressing the shoulder blades, drive elbows down-and-back to the lower chest, control a full overhead stretch each rep. Relax the jaw on the hard reps (no clench).
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: loop FTS cuffs or lifting straps so the closed hand isn't crush-gripping a bar under bodyweight+load. Wrist tendinopathy: neutral grip keeps the wrist straight. TMJ: unclench on top sets. Shoulder crepitus: painless = no restriction; neutral grip is shoulder-friendly.

exercises.load_guidance: Olympic bar (45 lb) + plates in 5-lb steps; this is your heaviest horizontal pull. Start where 8 reps sit at ~3 RIR (commonly 95-155 lb) and double-progress 6-10 reps, then +5-10 lb. Keep the torso angle fixed; if lower back fatigues or krav/CNS feels pre-cooked, cap at 8 reps @3 RIR rather than chasing load.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression (strength-leaning; the one free-barbell row of the week, placed Tue NOT Sat to keep the spine off the post-krav day)
exercises.cues: Brace, hinge to ~15-30° above horizontal, pull to the lower sternum/upper abdomen with elbows ~45°. Strap up so the back — not the grip — drives failure. Erectors work isometrically here, feeding the lower-back priority without a dedicated hinge on a Pull day.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: straps remove the crush-grip demand entirely (flagged item, grip_demand high → low with straps). Wrist tendinopathy: wraps optional. Lower-back priority: a controlled-torso strapped row loads erectors isometrically while painless — stop on any leg radiation/numbness. TMJ: relaxed jaw, no hard valsalva.

exercises.load_guidance: Precor/Hammer iso-lateral pulldown, selectorized or plate-loaded. One back-off set after the weighted pull-up to top the lats to 5 weekly heavy sets without more bodyweight grip load. Pick a load you control for 10-12 at 1-2 RIR; add a plate when you hit 12.
exercises.set_structure: RPT-style back-off (lighter than the pull-up, more reps) — a time-efficient way to add a 5th lat set, not 'extra growth'
exercises.cues: Chest-supported line of pull lets each lat work its own arc through a full overhead stretch to a hard contraction; let the scapula rise fully at the top for the lengthened position rows skip.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: handle is held, not hung — low grip demand; cuffs available if needed. Wrist: neutral/angled handle keeps the wrist comfortable. Counts toward the lat volume so the pull-up doesn't have to be taken deep before sport.

exercises.load_guidance: DBs in 5-lb steps to 75. Set the bench ~45-60°. Start where 10 reps sit at 1-2 RIR (commonly 20-35 lb/hand); double-progress 8-12 then next DB. Lengthened-biased curl prioritized over peak-contraction work for its modest measured growth edge.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression; take only the final set to 0-1 RIR (cheap isolation fatigue, last-set-to-failure premium)
exercises.cues: Let the arm hang fully behind the torso for a deep biceps stretch at the bottom — that lengthened position is the point. Supinate hard, no swing. Long head emphasis.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: 20-35 lb DBs are light enough to hold safely; if the pinky jams, switch to a Cable Curl with cuffs (same lengthened intent). Wrist: supinated DB grip is usually fine; reduce load if the wrist talks back.

exercises.load_guidance: Fixed EZ bar (to 60 lb) or loaded EZ on the Olympic side in 5-lb steps. One heavier overall-biceps set to round out the heavier-rep biceps pass (4 direct biceps sets Tue total with the incline work). Start ~40-65 lb for 8 at 1-2 RIR; double-progress then +5 lb.
exercises.set_structure: straight set (heavier, lower-rep biceps complement to the lengthened incline work — both heads loaded through a big-load full ROM)
exercises.cues: EZ camber spares the wrist vs a straight bar. Controlled tempo, no body english on a Pull day where the erectors already worked.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist tendinopathy: EZ bar's angled grip is the wrist-friendly choice over the straight barbell (less supination strain). Left pinky: if the closed-hand load bothers it, use FTS cuffs or swap to Machine Curl. TMJ: relaxed jaw.

exercises.load_guidance: FTS Glide cable, rope or dual handles at upper-chest height. Light-moderate; pick a load you can pause-contract for 15 reps at 0-2 RIR, add a pin when you hit 20. Doubles as rear-delt volume AND posterior-cuff/scapular prehab for the crepitus shoulder.
exercises.set_structure: straight set, pause at peak contraction (constant cable tension; trains rear delt + infraspinatus/teres minor + mid-trap in one move)
exercises.cues: Pull to the forehead/eyes with elbows high, externally rotating at the end so the knuckles face back. Squeeze, slow eccentric. This is your rear-delt + cuff insurance that keeps the presses painless.
exercises.accommodation: Shoulder crepitus: face pulls are the recommended scapular-stability/external-rotation prehab for this shoulder. Wrist/pinky: rope handle is light and held loosely; no crush-grip. Pure constant-tension cable, wrist neutral.

exercises.load_guidance: DBs to 75/hand (or loaded bar/handles). Walk 30-40 s at a load that challenges grip/trunk without form breakdown. Builds the lower-back/core priority isometrically and feeds forearm/trap volume — 2 forearm sets Tue.
exercises.set_structure: loaded carry (timed, anti-lateral-flexion isometric for erectors + QL; a Pull-day way to add to the lower-back priority off the heavy-hinge day)
exercises.cues: Tall posture, ribs down, brace as if holding a plank while walking. Trains erectors/QL and grip-trap endurance together — the functional-strength + running-tightness fix.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: use FTS cuffs or straps if a closed crush-grip on the handle jams the pinky (crush-grip is deferred while symptomatic; the carry still trains everything else). Wrist: neutral grip. Lower-back priority: painless loaded carry = progress; stop on red flags.

sessions.session_name: PULL B — Pump / Light Spinal Load (after krav AM)

exercises.load_guidance: Hammer/Precor chest-supported or plate-loaded row, selectorized or 5-lb plate steps. Higher-rep than Tue's barbell row. Start where 12 reps sit at 1-2 RIR; double-progress 10-15 then add a plate/pin. Torso support = near-zero lower-back demand, ideal after krav and after Wed's heavy hinge.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression (the Sat horizontal anchor; chest support removes the spinal/stabilizer cost on the post-krav day)
exercises.cues: Pin the chest to the pad, row to the lower ribs, drive elbows back, full protraction stretch at the front. No torso heave — the pad does the stabilizing so the mid-back drives failure.
exercises.accommodation: Lower-back priority: chest-supported = minimal erector fatigue, deliberately chosen because Wed already loaded the spine hard and krav was this AM. Left pinky: handles held, not hung; cuffs available. Wrist: neutral handle. Autoregulate — if krav was brutal, drop to 3 sets or +1 RIR.

exercises.load_guidance: FTS Glide cable / Precor pulldown, single handle. Per-side loading lets each lat reach an unrestricted overhead stretch. Start where 15 reps sit at 0-2 RIR; double-progress 12-20 then +1 pin. Stretch-biased vertical lat work for the lighter day.
exercises.set_structure: straight set, emphasize the stretch (single-arm = bigger ROM and a deeper lengthened position than the bilateral bar)
exercises.cues: Reach tall to let the scapula fully elevate/protract at the top, then pull the elbow to the hip pocket. Pause the stretch. Lengthened-position bias for the modest growth edge — not for 'region targeting,' which is refuted.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: cable handle held lightly with optional cuff; no bodyweight crush-grip (unlike a pull-up), so this is the pinky-friendly vertical option for the lighter day. Wrist: neutral handle.

exercises.load_guidance: High cable, straight arms, rope or bar. Light — this is the lengthened-lat isolation set that tops the lats to 4 weekly on the light day. Pick a load you can control to a hard contraction for 15-20 reps; add a pin at 20.
exercises.set_structure: straight set / lengthened-bias finisher (loads the lat where rows lose tension — the long stretched position, matching the lat's strength curve)
exercises.cues: Hinge slightly, sweep straight arms from overhead down to the thighs, feeling the lats stretch overhead and fully contract at the bottom. Stretch-biased lat add-on (a defensible heuristic, not 'rows are useless').
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky/wrist: low grip demand, neutral wrist, fully constant-tension cable — one of the most joint-friendly lat moves available. No spinal load on the post-krav day.

exercises.load_guidance: FTS Glide cable, straight or EZ attachment. Constant-tension high-rep biceps for the pump pass. Run the second set as a drop set for time-efficiency: hit failure ~20 reps, strip ~25%, continue. Start where 18-20 reps reach 0-1 RIR.
exercises.set_structure: set 1 straight, set 2 drop set (drop sets = equivalent growth at matched volume; used here purely to compress session time after krav, not for 'more growth')
exercises.cues: Constant cable tension top-to-bottom, no rest at lockout, squeeze each rep. High-rep at light load → train to 0-1 RIR so high-threshold units still fire.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: cable + cuff fully bypasses the grip (confirmed FTS workaround) — the reason cable beats hanging DBs for the symptomatic pinky. Wrist: neutral/EZ attachment keeps it comfortable.

exercises.load_guidance: FTS cable rope, neutral grip. Hits brachialis + brachioradialis (the second biceps pass spreads volume; also counts toward forearm/brachioradialis work). Start where 15 reps sit at 0-2 RIR; double-progress 12-20 then +1 pin.
exercises.set_structure: straight-double-progression (neutral-grip = wrist-friendly; rounds out the 2x/week biceps + adds brachioradialis)
exercises.cues: Neutral hammer path, keep the elbows pinned, drive the thumb toward the shoulder. Builds the brachialis under the biceps and the brachioradialis of the forearm in one move.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist tendinopathy: neutral grip is the recommended wrist-sparing variant. Left pinky: rope held loosely, cable-loaded, optional cuff — no crush-grip. Pure constant tension.

exercises.load_guidance: FTS Glide cables with wrist cuffs, crossed in front. Light — rear delt responds to high-rep constant tension. Run the last set as myo-reps (activation set to ~0-1 RIR, then 3-4 mini-sets of ~5 reps with 15-20 s rest) to save time. Start where 18-20 reps reach 0-1 RIR.
exercises.set_structure: 2 straight + 1 myo-reps final set (myo-reps = comparable growth in less time; used for time-efficiency on the pump day, not extra growth)
exercises.cues: Wrist cuffs let you forget the hands entirely and just feel the rear delt sweep open. Lead with the elbows, pause at full horizontal abduction. Rear-delt volume + posture work for the desk-and-running lifter.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: cuffs are the explicit confirmed FTS bypass — zero grip demand. Wrist: cuff means no wrist load at all. Shoulder crepitus: rear-delt/scapular work is part of keeping the shoulder healthy.

exercises.load_guidance: Low FTS cable, forearms supported, wrist flexion. Lengthened-bias wrist-flexor work — the third forearm set of the week (Sat carries 3 forearm sets with the hammer curl + this). Light; train to 0-2 RIR for 20-30 reps, add a pin when you top the range.
exercises.set_structure: straight set, high-rep (cable keeps tension through the lengthened bottom; finisher-style, low cost)
exercises.cues: Let the cable pull the wrist into full extension at the bottom for the stretch, then curl up. Keep the forearms locked on the bench/thigh so only the wrist moves.
exercises.accommodation: Wrist tendinopathy: cable lets the wrist move through a controlled, low-load arc — back off range/load if it's symptomatic (it's currently quiet). Left pinky: cable/low grip demand; finger-rolling and crush-grip (gripper/pinch/dead-hang) are DEFERRED while the pinky is symptomatic — this open wrist-flexion move is safe.

sessions.session_name: LEGS A — Moderate, Quad-Biased (strength-leaning squat anchor; protects the heavy Wed hinge)

exercises.load_guidance: Olympic bar (5-lb plate steps, ~570 lb ceiling). Start ~185 lb for 4x8 @2 RIR. Double-progress: add reps to 8 across all sets at 2 RIR, then +5-10 lb and drop back to 6. This is the quad/strength anchor of the week — keep a 2-RIR buffer (only the last set to 1) so you are not pre-fatigued for Wed's heavy deadlift.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression (low fatigue, best for the strength-leaning compound; RPT not used here so total CNS cost stays moderate before Wed)
exercises.cues: Squat to deep ROM (at/below parallel) for full quad length and knee-flexion ROM. Brace, knees track over mid-foot, sit down (knee-dominant) rather than sit back to keep the quads loaded through the longest range. Drive the floor away out of the hole.
exercises.accommodation: TMJ: keep jaw relaxed / use a mouthguard on the top sets — no hard clench during the valsalva brace. Bar on traps (no overhead/shoulder-press demand) so the painless-crepitus shoulder and quiet wrist are unloaded. No grip-limited hanging load, so the left pinky is a non-issue.

exercises.load_guidance: Olympic bar with straps. Start ~155-185 lb for 3x8 @2-3 RIR. Progress reps then +5-10 lb. Kept MODERATE on purpose (2-3 RIR, mid load) so the hamstring/glute/erector hinge stimulus is there twice a week without pre-cooking the lower back before the heavy Wed pull.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression (spare the spine on the hinge per Helms — chase failure on the isolation work later, not here)
exercises.cues: Soft knees, push hips straight back, feel the hamstring stretch, lower to mid-shin (long muscle length) and hard glute lockout. Flat neutral spine throughout — this is erector-endurance work too. Stop the set if bar speed or back position degrades.
exercises.accommodation: Lower-back PRIORITY build: painless = progress weekly; STOP on any leg radiation, numbness, give-way or night pain. Left pinky: lifting straps remove the grip limiter. Wrist tendinopathy: straps + neutral wrist keep it quiet. TMJ: relaxed jaw on the brace.

exercises.load_guidance: Precor selectorized leg-extension stack. Recline the seat back / extend the hip as far as the pad allows. Start at a load you hit 12 reps with at 1 RIR; add a plate when 3x12 @1 RIR is clean. Cheap fatigue here, so the last set goes to true failure.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression; final set as a brief drop (knock the pin down 1-2 plates, push to failure again) for time-efficient extra reps — equivalence technique, not 'more growth'
exercises.cues: Extended-hip seating lengthens the biarticular rectus femoris to bias its growth without costing vastus lateralis. Full lockout, controlled lengthened phase, no hip thrusting off the pad.
exercises.accommodation: Machine, no grip/wrist/shoulder demand — fully constraint-friendly. Pinky/wrist/shoulder all unloaded.

exercises.load_guidance: Precor selectorized seated leg-curl stack. Start at a load for 15 reps @2 RIR; double-progress reps to 15 then add a plate. The seated (hip-flexed) position trains the hip-extensor hamstring heads at long length — the directly-measured higher-growth curl variant.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression; can be antagonist-superset with the leg extension (order 3) to compress time — agonist/antagonist pairing is time-efficient with no growth penalty
exercises.cues: Hips fixed against the pad, full knee flexion squeeze, controlled lengthening. Drive the heels under, don't let the hips lift to cheat.
exercises.accommodation: Machine — grip/wrist/shoulder all bypassed. No pinky concern.

exercises.load_guidance: Smith machine (25-lb effective bar + plates, ~550 lb ceiling). Start ~135-185 lb across the hips for 3x12 @1-2 RIR; add 10-20 lb when the top of the range is clean. Shoulders on a bench, full hip extension, pause/squeeze at lockout.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression (constant short-length tension; Smith fixes the bar path so you can push close to failure safely)
exercises.cues: This is the SHORT-LENGTH glute complement to the squat/RDL's long-length loading — it is here for the length coverage it ADDS, not because it out-grows the squat (it does not). Posterior pelvic tilt at the top, chin tucked, ribs down. Use a pad across the hips.
exercises.accommodation: Smith bar across the hips, no grip/hang demand — pinky and wrist unloaded. No overhead/shoulder loading. TMJ: relaxed jaw at lockout.

exercises.load_guidance: Smith machine standing on a plate/block for full stretch (no dedicated calf machine exists at 290). Start ~135-185 lb for 3x10 @1-2 RIR; add 10 lb when 3x12 is clean. This is the heavier, lower-rep gastroc pass of the week (Wed gets the higher-rep soleus pass).
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression; emphasize a 2-3s loaded stretch and full lengthened-range bottom partials on the last set (lengthened bias is a reasonable add-on for the calf)
exercises.cues: Knee straight = gastrocnemius bias (the directly-measured growth result). Big stretch at the bottom, full plantarflexion squeeze at the top, no bouncing.
exercises.accommodation: Smith bar on traps/shoulders — no grip/hang load, pinky safe. Wrist neutral. TMJ: relaxed jaw if loading heavy.

exercises.load_guidance: Precor selectorized adduction stack. Open the pads to a deep abducted STRETCH, start at a load for 18 reps @1 RIR; add a plate when 2x20 is clean. Most adductor magnus stimulus already comes indirectly from the deep squat — this is the direct top-up.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets to 0-1 RIR (cheap isolation fatigue); optionally superset with a Copenhagen plank (8-15/side) for an eccentric/lengthened adductor + anti-lateral-flexion core two-for-one
exercises.cues: Full abducted stretch each rep, controlled return — long muscle length is where the adductor responds. If pairing Copenhagen, it doubles as lateral-chain core.
exercises.accommodation: Machine — no grip/wrist/shoulder demand. Copenhagen (if supersetted) is bodyweight, also constraint-free.

exercises.load_guidance: FTS / cable stack with rope. Start at a load for 15 reps @2 RIR; this is loadable and progressible so double-progress reps then weight. Core is a PRIORITY weak-point — load it like a muscle, not endurance fluff.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression; finish the session by giant-setting a Suitcase Carry (20-40s/side) as a time-cheap erector/QL anti-lateral-flexion + grip finisher (carries load the priority lower-back isometrically)
exercises.cues: Crunch the rib cage toward the pelvis (spinal flexion), don't just hip-hinge. On the carry finisher: stay tall, resist the side-bend, brace — this is anti-lateral-flexion and erector endurance for the running-tightness fix.
exercises.accommodation: Cable crunch: rope held at the head, minimal grip — pinky fine. Suitcase carry finisher: load via DB with a lifting strap or FTS cuff so the left pinky is bypassed; keep load moderate and wrist neutral.

sessions.session_name: LEGS B — Heavy Hinge / Lower-Back PRIORITY → Thu REST (heavy compound, then higher-rep pump accessories)

exercises.load_guidance: Olympic bar with straps. Start ~245-275 lb for 4x5 @2-3 RIR. Add 5-10 lb/week while it stays PAINLESS (the priority weak-point gets the most consistent load progression). Long rests (3.5-5 min). If pulling from the floor isn't fresh, sub a Barbell Good-Morning or RDL as the hinge.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression; this is the one place to bank a RIR buffer — keep 2-3 RIR (failure on the deadlift is slightly inferior for strength, triples acute fatigue, and threatens the priority lower back)
exercises.cues: Erector + glute + hamstring PRIMARY. Neutral braced spine, lats tight, push the floor away, lock out with the glutes. Reset each rep. Stop instantly on any leg radiation / numbness / give-way / sharp catch — those are red flags, not soreness.
exercises.accommodation: Lower-back PRIORITY: painless = progress; the listed red flags = stop and reassess. Placed Wed so the most fatiguing hinge is followed by Thu full rest, and kept off the krav/kickboxing days. Left pinky: STRAPS bypass the grip (no closed-hand hang fail). Wrist: neutral + straps. TMJ: relaxed jaw / mouthguard on the brace, no clench.

exercises.load_guidance: Olympic bar with straps. Start ~135-165 lb for 3x10 @2 RIR (lighter than the deadlift — this is the long-length ham/glute/erector secondary, run at higher reps for the pump pass). Double-progress reps then +5-10 lb while painless.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression at a deliberate long-length stretch (the longer-ROM direction is corroborated by hypertrophy trials on other hinges; erector fatigue caps usable extra ROM)
exercises.cues: Stiffer knees than the RDL, glute-max + erector at long muscle length, maximal hamstring stretch to mid-shin, hard lockout. Keep the spine neutral — back position quality is the limiter, not load.
exercises.accommodation: Lower-back priority — second hinge of the day, so autoregulate up a set/RIR if the deadlift was heavy. Straps bypass the pinky; neutral wrist. Stop on red flags.

exercises.load_guidance: Precor selectorized seated leg-curl. Higher-rep pump pass (15-20) vs Sun's 12-15 — same muscle, second weekly session split lighter/higher-rep per the load-independence of growth. Start at a 20-rep load @1 RIR; progress reps then weight.
exercises.set_structure: myo-reps or a double-drop on the last set (activation set to ~1 RIR, then 3-4 short-rest mini-clusters) — time-efficient way to bank effective reps, equivalent growth at matched volume, used for time/fatigue not 'more growth'
exercises.cues: Hip-flexed long-length curl for the hip-extensor heads. Full contraction squeeze, controlled stretch. Chase the burn here — isolation failure is cheap and captures the small hypertrophy premium.
exercises.accommodation: Machine — pinky/wrist/shoulder all bypassed.

exercises.load_guidance: Precor selectorized lying leg-curl. Start at a 20-rep load @1 RIR; progress reps then weight. Programmed alongside the seated curl to cover BOTH hamstring functions/heads (the prone hip angle and knee-flexion bias hit the short head differently than the seated variant).
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets to 0-1 RIR; optionally antagonist-superset with a light leg extension if quad volume feels low on Wed (quads are otherwise indirect from the deadlift here)
exercises.cues: Prone curl biases biceps femoris through the knee-flexion ROM. Hips pinned, no pelvis lift, full ROM both directions.
exercises.accommodation: Machine — fully constraint-friendly. No grip/wrist/shoulder load.

exercises.load_guidance: Plate-loaded hip-thrust machine. Start at a load for 3x15 @1-2 RIR; add a plate when the top of the range is clean. Very high SFR (the machine offloads the spinal setup vs barbell) — ideal after two heavy hinges when the lower back is already taxed.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / double-progression with an optional last-set myo-rep cluster for time-efficiency; short-length glute emphasis to complement the long-length hinge loading already done today
exercises.cues: Short-length peak-contraction glute work — included for the length coverage it ADDS to the squats/hinges, not as a superior glute builder. Full hip extension, posterior tilt, ribs down, pause at lockout.
exercises.accommodation: Machine, spine offloaded — lowest lower-back demand of the glute options, deliberately placed after the hinges. No grip/hang (pinky safe), no overhead (shoulder safe).

exercises.load_guidance: No leg-press or calf machine at 290 — rig the bent-knee soleus raise seated with a loaded barbell or heavy DBs resting across the knees (toes on a block for full stretch). Start at a load for 20-25 reps @1 RIR; progress reps then load. This is the higher-rep SOLEUS pass complementing Sun's standing gastroc pass.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets to 0-1 RIR with a deep loaded stretch and bottom lengthened partials on the last set — soleus responds to high reps and stretch
exercises.cues: Knee BENT = soleus bias (gastroc is slack at the knee, so seated reaches the soleus the standing raise misses). Slow full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top, no bouncing.
exercises.accommodation: Barbell/DB rests ON the thighs (not hung from the hand) so the left pinky and wrist carry no grip load — the constraint-clean way to rig this without the absent machine. Keep wrist neutral steadying the load.

exercises.load_guidance: Bodyweight; progress by ROM (knees → toes → standing) and lever length rather than added load. Start from knees for 3x10 @2 RIR; extend reach / move toward standing as you get stronger. This is the heavy anti-extension piece of the core PRIORITY build.
exercises.set_structure: straight-sets / ROM-progression (the lengthened-range anti-extension bias trains the whole rectus and braces the erectors as anti-extensors — the functional-strength fix)
exercises.cues: Brace hard, posterior pelvic tilt, resist lumbar extension as you roll out to the lengthened position — do NOT let the lower back sag. This is anti-extension, the bracing skill that pairs with the erector work for running tightness.
exercises.accommodation: Lower-back priority done SAFELY as anti-extension (no spinal loading/compression). Moderate grip on the wheel handles — fine for the pinky; if it jams, use a loaded barbell rollout with straps instead. Stop on any lumbar red flag.

exercises.load_guidance: DBs up to 75 lb each (the 290 DB ceiling) or a loaded barbell/trap setup. Start with a load you can carry tall and braced for 30-40s; progress load while posture stays perfect. Loads the erectors + QL isometrically and the traps — the carry pillar of the lower-back priority engine.
exercises.set_structure: straight loaded carries (timed); run as a finisher. For anti-lateral-flexion emphasis, alternate rounds as a SUITCASE carry (load one side) to hammer the QL/obliques
exercises.cues: Stand tall, ribs down, brace, walk smooth — the spine stays neutral under load (erector endurance), and suitcase rounds resist the side-bend (anti-lateral-flexion). This is the loaded-carry erector/core stimulus that no back-extension machine here can give.
exercises.accommodation: Left pinky: use FTS cable wrist cuffs or lifting straps so the closed-hand grip is fully bypassed (carries are otherwise grip-limited — straps let the erectors/QL drive). Wrist neutral. Crush-grip work (gripper/pinch/dead-hang) stays deferred while the pinky is symptomatic.

mesocycle.length_weeks: 10 weeks total = two stacked 4-week accumulation blocks + 1 deload after each (4+1, 4+1). Runs as one continuous mesocycle on top of the static PPL x2 (Sun Legs / Mon Push-heavy / Tue Pull+kickboxing / Wed Legs-heavy-hinge / Thu REST / Fri Push-pump / Sat Pull-lighter+krav). 10 wks is the floor for the Martikainen descending-RIR design (two 5-wk waves incl. deload) and lets the erector/core priority bank ~8 consecutive loaded weeks before the 8-12wk re-check; extend to 12 (three short blocks) only if joints/recovery are still rising at wk10.

blocks.focus: Re-groove every fixed-core compound at the new block's working weights after the prior deload. Hip-hinge erector/core PRIORITY already seeded at the TOP of its range. Fixed-core anchors: Wed heavy hinge = conventional or trap-bar deadlift (trap-bar = lower erector shear, claim regional_bias) cycling with RDL/SLDL; Mon heavy press = incline DB or machine/Smith incline press (shoulder-crepitus: NO heavy strict barbell OHP — constraint.mark.right-shoulder-crepitus); Sun squat = high-bar/front/Smith squat to depth (ml-deep-squat-more-leg-growth). Pull anchor = chest-supported / machine / cable rows + pulldown (frequency is just the volume vehicle — claim.16, loading frequency rows).
blocks.volume: ~10-12 hard sets/muscle/wk = MEV (weekly_sets intermediate MEV 8-12; RP MEV = mesocycle start). PRIORITY erectors/core enter at the HIGH end ~12-14 (split across Wed hinge + Sun/Sat carries + core slot) since painless+trainable (constraint.mark.lower-back). Per-session cap ~6-8 quality sets/muscle (session_sets hypertrophy 6-8 ceiling) — PPL x2 spreads the rest. ~6-9 weekly sets per smaller muscle.
blocks.intensity: RIR HIGH end of each block's wave. Heavy compounds (squat/deadlift/hinge/fixed-core press+pull) 3-4 RIR — strength is preserved across a wide RIR band and 0 RIR is slightly INFERIOR for squat/bench/DL (claim.17, claim.18, rir-strength intermediate 3-5 row: Robinson 2025/Ruple 2023). Isolation/machine/cable 2-3 RIR, no failure yet. Deadlift never past 2-3 RIR all block (protects the priority lower back). Double progression: add reps in range first, then +5 lb / next DB once top of range hit (tech.straight-sets).

blocks.focus: Same exercise pool held constant within the block (let the lifts express load progression — strength is a skill, claim.16/frequency-strength). Push the erector/core load most aggressively here: add reps/weight to RDL/SLDL/good-morning and loaded carries every week while painless. Pump-day advanced techniques switch ON (Fri Push, Sat Pull only): drop sets / rest-pause / myo-reps on cable & machine isolations purely for time + fatigue-economy, NOT extra growth (claim.13, tech.drop-set/rest-pause/myo-reps — all volume-equated-equivalent).
blocks.volume: Ramp +1-3 sets/muscle/wk: ~14 → ~17-18 hard sets/muscle by wk4 (weekly_sets MAV 12-20, +1-3/wk ramp). Erectors/core ride toward ~16-18 (its MAV ceiling). Most muscles touch ~18 (approaching MRV ~18-25) only by the final loaded week. Added volume lands on the pump days via the advanced techniques so per-session time stays bounded.
blocks.intensity: RIR walks DOWN across the block (descending-RIR = equal gains at LOWER average RPE, Martikainen 2025, rir-hypertrophy intermediate descending row). Heavy compounds 2-3 RIR now (last set of a non-deadlift press/squat may touch 1 RIR by wk4); deadlift stays 2-3 RIR, never failure. Isolation 0-2 RIR, final set of each isolation taken to failure (cheap fatigue, captures the small hypertrophy premium — rir-hypertrophy 0-2 isolation row). Light high-rep cable/calf work 0-1 RIR so high-threshold units recruit at light load (rir-hypertrophy 0-1 light-load row, load_pct_1rm 30-floor).

blocks.focus: Fatigue-shed, not detrain. Keep the movement patterns, drop the dose. Re-test nothing; just move well. Deadlift to a token top-set only or swap to trap-bar at light load to spare the erectors.
blocks.volume: ~half volume — drop to MV ~6 sets/muscle/wk (weekly_sets MV 6 maintenance row; RP deload to MV). Cut sets, not the exercises. Advanced techniques OFF.
blocks.intensity: 3-6 RIR all sets, no failure anywhere (rir-hypertrophy intermediate deload 3-6 row: directly removes the fatigue-generating last reps). Loads ~60-70% of block top sets.

blocks.focus: RESTART at MEV with the dynamic-accessory lifts ROTATED (see accessory_rotation) and fixed-core vari/grip rotated for joint health (e.g. trap-bar↔conventional↔RDL as the Wed hinge; incline DB↔machine incline↔Smith incline as the Mon press). Block B starts slightly heavier than Block A wk1 (new rep/load PRs carried over via double progression). Erector/core priority re-seeded at the top of range again.
blocks.volume: Re-enter ~11-13 sets/muscle (MEV), erectors/core ~13-15. Slightly above Block A's entry because tolerance rose (MAV note: tolerance climbs with accumulated training).
blocks.intensity: Reset RIR to the high end: heavy compounds 3-4 RIR, isolation 2-3 RIR. Re-establish the descending-RIR runway. Deadlift family again capped 2-3 RIR.

blocks.weeks: Block B · Wk8-9 (MAV ramp / peak loaded volume)
blocks.focus: Highest training stress of the mesocycle. Rotated accessories now loaded hard; pump-day advanced techniques ON again. This is where the erector/core weak-point gets its most consistent weekly load progression (still only while painless). Optional RPT intensification on 1-2 fixed-core compounds (see rpt_protocol) for time-efficient heavy exposure.
blocks.volume: Ramp to ~18-20 sets/muscle by wk9 (MAV top / brushing MRV 18-25). Erectors/core at their ~18-20 ceiling. Briefly touching MRV is fine; if wk9 performance can't match wk8 at equal rest, that muscle has hit MRV — hold or cut a set (MRV row: back off when performance drops).
blocks.intensity: Descend to the floor: heavy non-deadlift compounds 1-2 RIR (reserve 0-1 RIR for the very LAST set only — claim.18 / rir-hypertrophy trained 'last set only' row). Deadlift still 2-3 RIR, NEVER 0 — failure on the big barbell lifts ~triples acute neuromuscular fatigue and is slightly inferior for strength (rir-hypertrophy general 'failure ~3x fatigue' row, claim.17). Isolation 0-1 RIR, last set to failure.

blocks.focus: Deload as wk5, AND run the running re-check: re-read goals/constraints, log which muscles hit MRV early (candidates to cap next cycle), confirm the lower back stayed painless across all 8 loaded weeks, audit shoulder/wrist/pinky status, decide whether to extend to a 3rd short block (wk11-12) or restart a fresh mesocycle.
blocks.volume: MV ~6 sets/muscle, half the lifts cut. Techniques OFF.

mesocycle.rpt_protocol: Reverse-pyramid is applied ONLY to the fixed-core compounds (squat, deadlift/hinge, fixed-core incline press, fixed-core row) and ONLY as a loading-organization / time-efficiency tool — it is NOT more growth than equal-volume straight sets (claim.6 'reverse-pyramid more muscle' = equivalent; tech.reverse-pyramid: edge is order/freshness, not hypertrophy). Protocol: after warm-ups, the HEAVIEST top set is performed FIRST while fully fresh (claim.6 rationale: max tension/recruitment on the fresh set, unlike crescent pyramids), then load is dropped ~5-10% per back-off set to extend reps. Concrete on a fixed-core compound: Set1 = top set 4-6 reps @ the strength-leaning RIR for that block week (3-4 RIR early block, 2-3 RIR late; deadlift NEVER below 2-3 RIR — claim.17, rir-strength 3-5 row); Set2 = -7-10% for 6-8 reps @ 2 RIR; Set3 = -7-10% again for 8-10 reps @ 1-2 RIR. Use RPT on at most 1-2 fixed-core lifts per session so total fresh-heavy exposure stays manageable; the rest of the program runs straight sets with double progression (tech.straight-sets). RPT is the heavy-day vehicle (Mon heavy press, Wed heavy hinge, Sun squat); the pump days (Fri/Sat) use straight sets + advanced techniques instead. Load ceilings from the 290 algebra: Olympic bar to ~570 lb and Smith to ~550 give effectively unlimited barbell top-set room; DBs cap at 75 lb (load_algebra_290), so DB fixed-core presses will out-run the top end into higher reps — when a DB lift tops its range at 75 lb, push reps/tempo or migrate that slot to barbell/Smith/machine rather than chasing load. Wrist tendinopathy + left pinky: use neutral grip + FTS cuffs/straps on the heavy top sets (constraint.mark.right-wrist-tendonitis, constraint.mark.left-pinky); TMJ: relaxed jaw / mouthguard on the heavy top set's valsalva (constraint.mark.tmj).
mesocycle.accessory_rotation: Rotate the DYNAMIC-ACCESSORY lifts every block (~every 4-6 wks, at each deload boundary wk5 and wk10) for regional variety, joint health, and stimulus novelty; KEEP the fixed-core anchors stable within a block (only vary their grip/implement). Rotation is justified by joint-variety + ROM/length coverage, NOT by EMG/pump 'targeting' (emg-swelling-predicts-regional-growth = REFUTED). Pools (all from menu.json, dynamic-accessory role): BICEPS — Block A incline-dumbbell-curl (long-head stretch, mu-lengthened-curl-vs-preacher SUPPORTED) → Block B cable-curl/spider-curl (constant tension, drop-set friendly). TRICEPS — A overhead-cable-rope-extension (long-head stretch) → B rope-pushdown + skullcrusher. HAMSTRINGS split BOTH patterns every block (ml-rdl-hip-dominant-vs-leg-curl-knee-dominant SUPPORTED — program a hinge AND a curl): A = step/dumbbell-RDL + seated-leg-curl (hip-extensor heads at length, ml-seated-vs-lying-leg-curl SUPPORTED) → B = single-leg-RDL/good-morning + lying-leg-curl. QUADS — A leg-extension-extended-hip (reclined RF bias, ml-leg-extension-extended-hip-rectus-femoris SUPPORTED) + Bulgarian split squat → B sissy-squat/reverse-nordic (lengthened RF) + walking-lunge. CALVES — alternate standing (gastroc, ml-standing-vs-seated-calf SUPPORTED) machine/Smith/dumbbell variants block-to-block + ALWAYS keep one seated/bent-knee leg-press calf raise for soleus; add standing-calf lengthened-partials in Block B. DELTS — lateral: A dumbbell/lean-away-lateral-raise → B cable-cuff-lateral-raise (FTS grip-bypass for pinky) / machine-lateral-raise; rear: face-pull ↔ cable-cuff-rear-delt-fly; rotator-cuff + scapular work (cable-external-rotation, full-can-raise, serratus-punch) every Push AND Pull, NON-rotating (constraint.mark.right-shoulder-crepitus). BACK accessories — A chest-supported/incline-bench DB row + wide-grip pulldown → B seated-cable-row-neutral + lat-prayer/straight-arm-pulldown (long-length lat work; mu-row-vs-pulldown bias is only an activation heuristic, not differential growth — REFUTED, so rotate for variety not 'targeting'). GLUTES — hip-thrust variants (machine/Smith/American) ↔ kickbacks + abduction, IN for the short-length emphasis they add, NOT as a squat replacement (ml-hip-thrust-vs-squat-glute-growth REFUTED; ml-hip-thrust-short-length complementary). CORE/ERECTOR (priority, rotates but never drops below its high range): A ab-wheel-rollout (anti-ext) + suitcase-carry (anti-lateral-flexion) + cable-crunch → B weighted-plank/captains-chair-leg-raise + farmers-carry + cable-side-bend; erector loading itself runs through the rotating hinge anchors + good-morning since NO 45-deg/GHD back-ext machine exists (equipment_notes: absent). Grip-loaded accessories (rows, carries, RDLs) ALWAYS use FTS cuffs/straps (constraint.mark.left-pinky); defer crush-grip work (gripper/pinch/dead-hang) until the pinky settles.
mesocycle.deload: Cadence: a deload week every 5th week — wk5 and wk10 — i.e. after each 4-week accumulation block (the descending-RIR block ends near the fatigue floor, so deload is scheduled, not reactive). HOW: cut to ~half volume = MV ~6 hard sets/muscle/wk (weekly_sets MV 6 maintenance row; RP deload-to-MV) by dropping sets and removing the back-end accessories, while KEEPING the movement patterns so skill/load is retained. Hold ALL sets at 3-6 RIR with NO sets to failure anywhere (rir-hypertrophy intermediate deload 3-6 row — raising RIR directly removes the fatigue-generating last reps that Refalo showed cost ~3x neuromuscular fatigue and outlast 24h). Loads ~60-70% of the block's top sets. Advanced techniques (drop/rest-pause/myo-reps) OFF during deload (they are high/moderate fatigue_cost, tech rows). The deadlift is deloaded hardest — token light top-set or trap-bar only — to fully unload the priority erectors. EARLY/REACTIVE deload trigger (insert off-schedule): if you can't match the prior week's performance on a lift despite full rest, that's MRV (weekly_sets MRV row) — take that week as a deload or restart at MEV. Each deload also doubles as the autoregulation reset (re-baseline RIR for the next block) and wk10's deload carries the 8-12wk re-check.
autoregulation_rules: SPORTS ARE NOT TRAINING VOLUME — the lifting stands alone; on heavy-sport-overlap weeks you dial the LIFTING DOWN rather than leaning on the sport for stimulus (philosophy: self-sufficient). Levers, in order: (1) +1-2 RIR on the affected session, (2) drop the last 1-2 accessory sets, (3) keep big lifts at 2-3 RIR and never to failure on sport-adjacent days.

TUESDAY (Pull, kickboxing PM): Pull is deliberately on the kickboxing day so legs/push power stay fresh for the sport (scheduling_rules). Keep Tue compound rows at 2-3 RIR, never to failure; if kickboxing was brutal last week or you feel pre-fatigued, drop the last 1-2 isolation sets — do NOT add volume on top into overreaching.

SATURDAY (Pull-lighter, krav AM): Sat is the lighter chest-supported/machine Pull AFTER krav (scheduling_rules: Sat lighter). Run it +1 RIR vs a fresh day, lean on machine/cable + advanced techniques (low skill, low systemic cost). If krav was unusually hard, cut Sat to MV-ish (cut sets) or skip the pump finishers — never make it up by piling onto Sun/Mon.

WEDNESDAY heavy hinge is islanded before Thursday REST (scheduling_rules) and kept clear of krav/kickboxing days — protect this slot. If the week's sport load was high, hold the hinge at 2-3 RIR and trim accessory hinge volume, but keep the erector/core PRIORITY dose at the high end of its range whenever painless (constraint.mark.lower-back: priority build, not avoidance).

PICKLEBALL / variable extra sport: treat as added systemic fatigue, not stimulus. If a given week stacks pickleball onto kickboxing+krav, raise RIR by 1 across that week's heavy compounds and let the deload absorb the rest — missing lifting volume is made up later in the week or simply skipped, never added on top.

WITHIN-BLOCK RIR AUTOREGULATION: ride the descending-RIR wave (start ~3-4 RIR, finish ~1 RIR on non-deadlift compounds and isolation) — matched gains at LOWER average RPE (Martikainen, rir-hypertrophy intermediate descending row). Heavy compounds 3-5 RIR early → 2-3 late, last set may touch 0-1 RIR ONLY on non-deadlift presses/squats (claim.18). Isolation 0-2 RIR, final set to failure. Light high-rep cable/calf 0-1 RIR (load-dependent failure requirement, rir-hypertrophy 0-1 light-load row).

DEADLIFT / heavy hinge NEVER to momentary failure — 0 RIR ~triples acute neuromuscular fatigue, is slightly inferior for strength, and on the deadlift it threatens the priority lower back (claim.17, claim.18, rir-strength 3-5 row: Robinson/Ruple). Cap it 2-3 RIR every set, all block.

LOWER-BACK MONITORING (priority weak-point, painless=continue): the erector/core gets the HIGH end of its volume range and the most consistent weekly load progression — but ONLY while it stays painless. STOP and reassess on any red flag (constraint.mark.lower-back red_flags): pain radiating into buttock/leg, numbness/tingling, leg weakness/foot-drop, bladder/bowel changes, night or rest pain, sharp catching/give-way. Any of these = pull hinge load back to pain-free ROM/load, swap to trap-bar/supported variants, and re-check before re-loading.

CONSTRAINTS ALWAYS ON: shoulder painless-crepitus → neutral-grip DB / machine / Smith incline are the press anchors, NO heavy strict barbell OHP, rotator-cuff+scapular work every Push/Pull (get assessed before any heavy strict overhead) — constraint.mark.right-shoulder-crepitus. Wrist tendinopathy → neutral grip / wraps / cable-machine where wrist stays neutral — constraint.mark.right-wrist-tendonitis. Left pinky (temporary) → FTS cuffs/straps/machine on every grip-loaded pull/hinge/carry; defer crush-grip — constraint.mark.left-pinky. TMJ → relaxed jaw / mouthguard, no hard clench on heavy/valsalva sets — constraint.mark.tmj.

RUNNING 8-12wk RE-CHECK (at wk10 deload): re-read goals + constraints; log which muscles hit MRV early (cap them next cycle); confirm lower back stayed painless across all 8 loaded weeks; audit shoulder/wrist/pinky; decide extend-to-12 (3rd short block) vs restart at MEV. Advanced techniques stay confined to the Fri/Sat pump days for time-efficiency/fatigue-management only — never as 'more growth' (claim.13: equivalent at matched volume).
